content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: in all three windows the user clicks the Apply span at the same coordinates 5 times over about 1 s (for example ids 122, 128, 133, 139, 144), and no navigation, overlay, or error event follows any of these clicks, so the click appears to produce no visible response that would stop repeat clicks.", "fix": "Fix: On the ir swap screen, give the Apply button an immediate pending state on its click handler (disable it and show a spinner or \"Applying\u2026\" label until the response returns), and show a visible result or validation message near Apply when the request completes or is rejected.", "cited_event_ids": ["122", "128", "133", "139", "144", "120", "125", "131", "136", "142", "122", "128", "134", "139", "145"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The event data does not show what the Apply handler does, whether it sends a request, or whether it validates input.", "No visible error, navigation, or overlay event appears after the Apply clicks in the windows, but the windows may not capture a delayed or off-screen response.", "The visible error events on Trade Date (for example 53:a54, 57:a59) occur before Apply and cannot be confirmed as the reason Apply does not respond.", "Whether users in other sessions saw a response after the windows end is not in the data."]}
